name: Kingdom of Rimatara (1856–1891)
description: Three horizontal stripes of red, white and red, the white stripe charged with a red cross formed of four triangles meeting at their points.
history: The flag of the small kingdom of Rimatara in the Austral Islands, used from 1856; in 1891 a version with a French canton marked the protectorate, and the island was annexed in 1900.
